name: Integration Grid
summary: A 3D-tilted 8x3 grid of rounded integration tiles with a staggered rise-in reveal, spring-like hover lift, click ripples that spread across neighbours, idle pulses and a bottom fade mask; scales to fit from desktop to 390px.
useWhen: A landing page wants to show the tools or services a product connects with
A logo wall should feel tactile with hover lift and ripple feedback
avoidWhen: A flat marquee of logos is enough
Each integration needs a detailed card with description
